territories.name: 01 THE EXECUTIVE DOSSIER
territories.concept: CINEMATIC · PREMIUM · STRUCTURED — a polished, editorial experience that treats the quarter like a formal dossier.
territories.metaphor: EXECUTIVE DOSSIER — a bound quarter filing packet
territories.primary_object: THE QUARTER as a physical filing packet (binder object)
territories.composition_logic: One hero object (the packet) anchors the page; the checklist is its table of contents.
territories.mobile_logic: Stacked: hero card → stepper → packet → checklist → panels → next action.
territories.desktop_logic: Not shown in the selection board.
territories.experience_fit: Matches the packet-builder archetype of the experience contract.
territories.founder_decision: NOT SELECTED — retained as lineage (founder LOVE_IT went to T03 rendered LIGHT).

territories.family_id: F06 SERVICES (permits-taxes-compliance) · F04 ROAD READY item · F16 VAULT tax_fuel
territories.name: 02 THE SPATIAL WORKROOM
territories.concept: IMMERSIVE · INTERACTIVE · OPERATIONAL — an environment-driven experience where the quarter becomes a physical workroom.
territories.metaphor: SPATIAL WORKROOM — six glass cubes on a round platform
territories.primary_object: THE QUARTER as an immersive room of six step cubes
territories.composition_logic: Spatial navigation replaces lists: the room is the interface.
territories.mobile_logic: Hero → stepper → 2×3 cube grid → panels → continue.
territories.desktop_logic: Not shown in the selection board.
territories.experience_fit: Expresses the six-step quarter; weak on compartments-as-data.
territories.founder_decision: NOT SELECTED — retained as lineage (founder LOVE_IT went to T03 rendered LIGHT).

territories.name: 03 THE ANALYTICS COMMAND
territories.concept: DATA-RICH · MODERN · HIGH-CONTROL — a focused, analytical experience centred on live data, maps and actionable insights.
territories.metaphor: ANALYTICS COMMAND — the quarter as a live command view
territories.primary_object: THE QUARTER (Q3 2026) — high-visibility quarter identity with live metrics
territories.composition_logic: Hero perimeter → data → tabs → panels → one next action; tabs are compartments of one quarter.
territories.mobile_logic: Single column: hero → metrics rail → scrollable tab bar → stacked panels → next-action rail → lower band.
territories.desktop_logic: Three-column panel grid under hero + metrics + tabs (CLIENT_TABLET_DESKTOP).
territories.brand_fit: Executive industrial × modern infrastructure × operational luxury.
territories.experience_fit: Desktop behaviour of the contract already models compartments as tabs of one packet.
territories.founder_decision: LOVE_IT — approved as LIGHT ANALYTICS COMMAND (client parent authority).
